invariants.rationale: The method returns a non-null HoodieIndex instance, as all return statements construct or fetch and return a HoodieIndex object.
If config.getIndexClass() is not null or empty, the method returns the result of HoodieIndexUtils.createUserDefinedIndex(config).

invariants.expression: StringUtils.isNullOrEmpty(config.getIndexClass()) ? (config.getIndexType() == HoodieIndex.IndexType.SIMPLE || config.getIndexType() == HoodieIndex.IndexType.GLOBAL_SIMPLE || config.getIndexType() == HoodieIndex.IndexType.INMEMORY || config.getIndexType() == HoodieIndex.IndexType.BLOOM) : true
invariants.rationale: If the index class is empty or null, result comes from one of the four supported index types.
Result is always an instance of HoodieIndex or its subclass.
config is used in method body, so must not be null.
